name: Ateca (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and purple below, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Ateca.
history: Municipal flag of Ateca; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Ateca arms — bars of Aragon and a castle, within a border inscribed MUY ILUSTRE VILLA DE ATECA
crown and bars of the arms
